name: Ano Post o Wasurenai
original_name: あのポストを忘れない
source:
You're just a regular girl. One day, on your way home, you come upon a post box.
You are then sucked into it, and while you defeat villains, you start meeting beautiful men...

[Translated from [url=http://lightbreeze.ivory.ne.jp/game/anoposu.htm]the official website[/url]]
